headline: "MINIMUM WAGE IN SERBIA WILL BE 600 EUROS" Mali speaks out: We will adopt the decision at the next session
summary: Siniša Mali said six parameters, including GDP growth, labour market, inflation and macroeconomic stability, are considered when setting the minimum wage, which will be decided at the next session.
why: The minimum wage sets a wage floor that affects labour costs, household incomes and inflation expectations.
